method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ AMH'S OWN FIRST LINE IS THAT TREATMENT OF INFERTILITY IS HIGHLY SPECIALISED AND DEPENDS ON THE CAUSE. That caveat leads the guideline. ⚠️ NO DOSE OR REGIMEN APPEARS ANYWHERE -- AMH's table lists PRODUCT STRENGTHS AND PACK SIZES, WHICH ARE NOT DOSES, and the compendium does not convert one into the other. Product strengths are recorded as dose claims because a reader could mistake them for doses.

claims.claim: ⚠️ AMH'S OWN FIRST LINE: TREATMENT OF INFERTILITY IS HIGHLY SPECIALISED AND DEPENDS ON THE CAUSE
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ANOVULATORY INFERTILITY IS USUALLY TREATED FIRST LINE WITH LETROZOLE OR CLOMIFENE. Other aromatase inhibitors or selective estrogen receptor modulators are OCCASIONALLY used. GONADOTROPHINS (FOLLICLE STIMULATING HORMONES) MAY BE USED, eg IF ORAL THERAPIES ARE UNSUCCESSFUL
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: IN WOMEN WITH POLYCYSTIC OVARY SYNDROME, METFORMIN MAY BE ADDED TO CLOMIFENE OR LETROZOLE. ⚠️ METFORMIN ALONE MAY OCCASIONALLY BE USED BUT IS LESS EFFECTIVE THAN LETROZOLE, CLOMIFENE, OR CLOMIFENE WITH METFORMIN. ⚠️ LIFESTYLE CHANGES SUCH AS WEIGHT LOSS IF OBESE MAY ALSO HELP RESTORE FERTILITY
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: WOMEN WITH HYPOPITUITARISM REQUIRE FSH -- eg FOLLITROPIN -- AND LH -- eg LUTROPIN ALFA. HCG AND/OR FSH MAY BE USED IN INFERTILE MALES WITH HYPOPITUITARISM
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: BROMOCRIPTINE OR CABERGOLINE may be used to NORMALISE PROLACTIN LEVELS IN WOMEN WITH HYPERPROLACTINAEMIA THAT PREVENTS OVULATION, WHEN SURGERY IS NOT INDICATED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ASSISTED REPRODUCTIVE TECHNOLOGIES such as IVF may include DOWN REGULATION WITH GnRH AGONISTS (eg NAFARELIN, TRIPTORELIN) OR GnRH ANTAGONISTS (GANIRELIX OR CETRORELIX) and ARTIFICIAL STIMULATION OF OVARIAN FOLLICLE GROWTH BY GONADOTROPHINS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: HCG IS USED IN GONADOTROPHIN-INDUCED OVULATION AND IVF TO TIME (TRIGGER) RELEASE OF EGGS FROM THE OVARIAN FOLLICLES, and rarely for luteal phase support. ⚠️ THE COMBINATION OF GnRH AGONISTS, GONADOTROPHINS AND HCG IS ASSOCIATED WITH A RISK OF SERIOUS OVARIAN HYPERSTIMULATION. ⚠️ IN PROTOCOLS USING GnRH ANTAGONISTS, GnRH AGONISTS (eg TRIPTORELIN) MAY BE USED INSTEAD OF HCG TO TRIGGER EGG RELEASE, WITH LITTLE RISK OF OVARIAN HYPERSTIMULATION
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: PROGESTERONE IS USED FOR LUTEAL PHASE SUPPORT IN ASSISTED CONCEPTION CYCLES. ⚠️ IT IS ESSENTIAL WHEN OVULATION AND NATURAL PROGESTERONE PRODUCTION DO NOT OCCUR, eg TREATMENT WITH DONOR OOCYTES, and IT IS RARELY INDICATED IN NATURAL CONCEPTIONS
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ MOST INFERTILITY DRUGS ARE PBS-S100 IVF PROGRAM ITEMS. Exceptions noted by AMH: CHORIOGONADOTROPIN ALFA, FOLLITROPIN ALFA AND FOLLITROPIN BETA ARE ALSO PBS-R for infertility indications other than ART, and CLOMIFENE IS PBS-R for anovulatory infertility and in-vitro fertilisation
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ THREE DRUGS ARE USED OUTSIDE THEIR MARKETED INDICATIONS, as AMH notes: LETROZOLE for ovulation induction in PCOS is NOT A MARKETED INDICATION; METFORMIN for the same is NOT A MARKETED INDICATION; and NAFARELIN IS NOT MARKETED FOR OVULATION INDUCTION. ⚠️ CHORIOGONADOTROPIN ALFA IS NOT MARKETED FOR USE IN MEN, despite HCG being listed for stimulation of spermatogenesis
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ HCG ITSELF IS NOT MARKETED IN AUSTRALIA but may be available via the SPECIAL ACCESS SCHEME OR SECTION 19A APPROVAL. It ACTS AS LH. HUMAN MENOPAUSAL GONADOTROPHIN ACTS AS BOTH LH AND FSH
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: CORIFOLLITROPIN ALFA is a LONG-ACTING GONADOTROPHIN USED WITH A GnRH ANTAGONIST and GIVEN AS A SINGLE SC DOSE. LUTROPIN ALFA, alone or combined with follitropin alfa, is for STIMULATION OF FOLLICULAR DEVELOPMENT IN SEVERE LH AND FSH DEFICIENCY, DEFINED BY AMH AS LH BELOW 1.2 IU/L. GOSERELIN for pituitary down regulation is RARELY USED
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22

claims.claim: ⚠️ PRODUCT STRENGTHS ARE NOT DOSES. AMH's table lists, for example, follitropin alfa pens at 75, 150, 225, 300, 450 and 900 IU; follitropin beta at 300, 600 and 900 IU; follitropin delta at 12, 36 and 72 microgram; corifollitropin alfa at 100 and 150 microgram; choriogonadotropin alfa at 250 microgram; lutropin alfa at 75 IU; cetrorelix at 250 microgram; ganirelix at 500 microgram/mL; goserelin implant 3.6 mg; nafarelin nasal spray 200 microgram/dose; triptorelin 100 microgram/mL; clomifene 50 mg scored tablets; letrozole 2.5 mg; metformin 500 mg, 850 mg and 1 g; and progesterone pessaries at 100, 200, 300 and 400 mg with an 8% vaginal gel and a 25 mg injection. ⚠️ NO REGIMEN, FREQUENCY OR DURATION IS GIVEN FOR ANY OF THEM
claims.locator: AMH Medicines, 'Infertility' at https://amhonline.amh.net.au/chapters/endocrine-drugs/drugs-infertility/infertility, July 2026 release ('Last modified by AMH: July 2026'), read under subscription 2026-09-22
